theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 28 群

items.colloc: make a decision 做決定 | make a profit 獲利
items.distinct: do 進行（工作）| create 創造（從無到有）
ex: Please make a copy of this report.
請幫我影印這份報告。
We hope to make a profit this year.
我們希望今年能獲利。
Did you make a reservation for the lunch?
你有預訂午餐位子嗎？

items.colloc: by all means 務必 | by means of 藉由...
items.distinct: method 特定步驟的方法 | way 一般的途徑
ex: Hard work is the means to success.
努力工作是成功的途徑。
They have the means to expand overseas.
他們有財力進行海外擴張。
Is there any other means to solve this?
還有其他方法可以解決這個嗎？

items.colloc: hold a meeting 舉行會議 | attend a meeting 出席會議
items.distinct: conference 大型研討會 | session 會期；開會期間
ex: Everyone is required to attend the meeting.
每個人都被要求參加會議。
Can we hold a meeting tomorrow morning?
我們明天早上可以開個會嗎？
The meeting was moved to the conference room.
會議改到會議室進行了。

items.pos: v. 提到；說起 | n. 提及
items.colloc: mention briefly 簡短提及 | worth mentioning 值得一提
items.distinct: refer to 參考；提及 | state 陳述
ex: The manager did not mention the budget cuts.
經理沒有提到預算削減的事。
Did he mention anything about the new project?
他有提到關於新專案的事嗎？
It is worth mentioning that sales increased.
值得一提的是銷售額增加了。

items.colloc: mounting pressure 上升的壓力 | mounting debt 累積的債務
items.distinct: increasing 漸增的 | rising 上升的
ex: There is mounting pressure to finish early.
提前完成的壓力越來越大。
The company faces mounting costs this quarter.
公司本季面臨不斷增加的成本。
We feel mounting concern about the delay.
我們對延遲感到日益擔憂。

items.colloc: narrowly escaped 勉強逃脫 | narrowly defeated 險勝
items.distinct: barely 幾乎不 | slightly 稍微
ex: The company narrowly avoided a financial crisis.
公司險些躲過一場財務危機。
Our team was narrowly defeated in the finals.
我們的團隊在決賽中以些微差距落敗。
They narrowly missed the deadline for submission.
他們勉強錯過了提交期限。

items.colloc: absolutely necessary 絕對必要 | take necessary steps 採取必要措施
items.distinct: essential 不可或缺的 | required 被規定的
ex: It is necessary to review the contract.
審閱這份合約是有必要的。
Please take the necessary steps to fix it.
請採取必要措施來修復它。
Extra funds are necessary for the upgrade.
升級需要額外的資金。

items.pos: v. 需要 | n. 需求
items.colloc: meet the need 滿足需求 | urgent need 急需
items.distinct: require 規定需要 | demand 強烈要求
ex: We need to hire more staff soon.
我們很快就需要雇用更多員工。
There is a great need for new equipment.
對新設備有很大的需求。
Do you need assistance with the software?
你需要軟體方面的協助嗎？

items.colloc: negative feedback 負面意見 | negative impact 負面影響
items.distinct: pessimistic 悲觀的 | critical 批評的
ex: The client gave us negative feedback today.
客戶今天給了我們負面意見。
Inflation will have a negative impact here.
通貨膨脹會對這裡產生負面影響。
We should avoid a negative attitude toward change.
我們應避免對變革採取負面態度。

items.colloc: obtain permission 取得許可 | obtain information 獲得資訊
items.distinct: get 得到（通用） | acquire 購得；習得
ex: How can we obtain a building permit?
我們該如何取得建築許可？
The researchers hope to obtain better results.
研究人員希望獲得更好的結果。
Please obtain a copy of the receipt.
請取得一份收據副本。

items.colloc: in operation 運作中 | business operation 業務營運
items.distinct: function 功能 | procedure 程序
ex: The new factory is now in full operation.
新工廠現在已全面營運。
He is responsible for daily office operations.
他負責日常的辦公室營運。
We need to simplify the operation process.
我們需要簡化操作流程。

items.colloc: take the opportunity 把握機會 | equal opportunity 平等機會
items.distinct: chance 偶然的機會 | occasion 場合
ex: This is a great opportunity to grow.
這是成長的絕佳機會。
I look forward to the opportunity to work.
我期待有這個工作的機會。
Take the opportunity to ask your questions.
把握機會提出你的問題。

items.colloc: have the option 選項 | available options 可用的選項
items.distinct: choice 選擇 | alternative 二選一的選擇
ex: We have several options for the vendor.
我們針對供應商有幾個選項。
What is the best option for our budget?
以我們的預算來說哪個選項最好？
You have the option to renew the lease.
你有續租的選擇權。

items.colloc: organize a meeting 籌辦會議 | organize files 整理檔案
items.distinct: arrange 排列；約定 | structure 建構
ex: She will organize the upcoming sales event.
她將籌辦即將到來的銷售活動。
Please organize your files before leaving today.
請在今天下班前整理好你的檔案。
We need to organize the team better.
我們需要更好地組織這個團隊。

items.colloc: probation period 試用期 | trial period 試用期
items.distinct: stage 階段 | era 時代
ex: The project has a three-month trial period.
該專案有三個月的試用期。
During this period, sales were very high.
在此期間，銷售額非常高。
We need to focus on this growth period.
我們需要專注於這個成長階段。

items.colloc: obtain permission 獲得許可 | with permission 經允許
items.distinct: authorization 授權 | consent 同意
ex: You need permission to access the server.
你需要許可才能存取伺服器。
Did you ask for permission to leave early?
你有申請早退的許可嗎？
No one can enter without my permission.
沒有我的許可任何人不得進入。

items.colloc: first phase 第一階段 | initial phase 初期階段
items.distinct: period 一段時間 | step 步驟
ex: The first phase of the project is done.
專案的第一階段已經完成了。
We are entering a new phase of growth.
我們正進入一個新的成長階段。
The next phase involves extensive market research.
下一階段涉及廣泛的市場研究。

items.colloc: in preparation for 為...做準備 | make preparations 進行準備
items.distinct: readiness 就緒狀態 | training 訓練
ex: Much preparation is needed for the event.
活動需要大量的準備工作。
We are doing this in preparation for audit.
我們正在為審計做準備。
The team made preparations for the arrival.
團隊為訪客的抵達做了準備。

items.colloc: highly probable 極有可能 | probable cause 合理理由
items.distinct: possible 可能的（機會較小） | likely 很可能的
ex: It is probable that he will be promoted.
他很有可能會被升職。
What is the probable cost of this repair?
這項維修大概的費用是多少？
There is a probable delay in shipment.
出貨很有可能會延遲。

items.pos: n. 前景；預期；潛在客戶
items.colloc: job prospect 工作前景 | business prospect 商業展望
items.distinct: perspective 觀點 | expectation 期望
ex: The job prospect in this field is good.
該領域的工作前景很不錯。
We are contacting a new sales prospect today.
我們今天正在聯絡一位潛在客戶。
The economic prospect remains uncertain this year.
今年的經濟展望仍不確定。
